name: mcp
title: MCP Hub
description: A hub of MCP servers — aggregates the open-source Model Context Protocol ecosystem (official registry, GitHub, npm, Glama, Smithery, awesome-lists, the local mod fleet) into one searchable directory, live-probes servers for their real tool lists, and lets anyone publish their own: wallet-signed with a browser or locally derived key, manifest pinned by CID to the store mod

sources.docs: Provider catalog: id, label, what it indexes, cache TTL and whether it wants a key

search.docs: Search every provider at once: q, sources=, oss=1 (open source only, default), transport=, license=, tag=, sort=relevance|stars|downloads|new, limit=. The same project seen in several directories collapses onto one card by repo URL

server.docs: GET /server?id= — one server card, merged across every provider that lists it, with install recipes and probed tools when known

probe.docs: Live MCP handshake against a remote server URL (initialize + tools/list): protocol version, server info and the real tool inventory; cached

client_config.docs: GET /client_config?id=&client=claude|cursor|vscode|cli — ready-to-paste MCP client config (or a `claude mcp add` command) for a server

submit.docs: Publish an MCP server to the hub. The manifest is pinned to the store mod under the submitter's own address (CID recorded here); needs a mod protocol token — browser wallet or locally derived key

submissions.docs: GET community-submitted servers (?mine=1 with auth for your own); DELETE /submissions?id= removes your own (the hub owner may remove any)

stats.docs: Hub totals: servers per provider, submissions, probed servers, cache state

mcp.docs: The hub is itself an MCP server (JSON-RPC 2.0, Streamable HTTP): mcp_sources, mcp_search, mcp_server, mcp_probe, mcp_client_config, mcp_stats (public); mcp_submit, mcp_submissions (mod protocol Bearer token)

env.MCP_HUB_DIR: Off-tree state: submissions index, provider + probe cache, owner (default: ~/.mod/mcp)
env.MCP_STORE_URL: store mod API used to pin submission manifests (default: http://localhost:50152)
env.MCP_GITHUB_TOKEN: Optional GitHub token — lifts the 10 searches/min anonymous budget (also read from ~/.mod/mcp/github.token)
env.MCP_SESSION_TTL: Max protocol-token age in seconds (default: 604800 / 7 days)
